title: Writing an Email
drDigitalIntro:
To write an email, click the compose button and fill in three things.
• To: the recipient's email address — spell it correctly or it won't arrive.
• Subject: a short description of what the email is about. Keep it clear.
• Body: the actual message. Write it like a short letter.
• When you are ready, click Send. The email arrives in seconds.
• Tip: press Tab to jump between fields, and Shift+Tab to go back.

playgroundTask.goal: Compose and send your first email

steps.say: Click the Compose button (pencil icon) to start a new email.
Type the recipient's address in the To field: friend@example.com
Click the Subject field and type: Greetings from me!
Click the body area and type your message: Hi there! I am learning to send emails.
Click Send to deliver the email.

drDigitalSuccess: Email sent! You filled in To, Subject, and the body — the three things every email needs. From now on you can write to anyone.
drDigitalHint: Work through each field from top to bottom: To → Subject → body → Send.
